crossRefs.note: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness…
but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to.…
Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.
The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came…
An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,
in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
“For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is…
There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me…
They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…
They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’
He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in…
You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about…
But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.
But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
translations.bsb: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
translations.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
translations.asv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven or from men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why then did ye not believe him?
